title: Lattice Configuration
description: Schema for lattice.json — the root configuration of a Lattice polyglot monorepo (PRD §11). Uses a no-globs, per-workspace-object model.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON Schema (e.g. ".lattice/schema.json").

latticeVersion.description: Version of Lattice this config targets.

workspaces.description: Explicitly declared workspaces. Each entry is a single project directory (no globs).

engines.description: Root-level toolchain defaults for all workspaces.

pipeline.description: Named tasks and how they relate across the workspace graph.

maxCacheSize.description: Upper bound on the local cache size (e.g. "10GB").

path.description: Literal directory path (relative to repo root) to the workspace. Never a glob.

name.description: Workspace name; defaults to the basename of `path`.

auto.description: When true (default), infer engine and task commands from the native manifest.

engines.description: Per-workspace toolchain constraints; overrides/pins the inferred engine.

dependsOn.description: Other workspaces (by name) this one depends on.

custom.description: Custom engine definitions keyed by an arbitrary name.

versionCmd.description: Command that prints the tool's version (e.g. "g++ --version").

dependsOn.description: Task dependencies. `^task` means the same task in dependency workspaces.

inputs.description: File globs hashed to determine cache keys.

outputs.description: File globs captured as cached artifacts.

ignore.description: File globs excluded from input hashing.

env.description: Environment variable names that affect the task's cache key.

persistent.description: When true, the task is long-running (e.g. a dev server) and never cached.

cache.description: Whether outputs of this task are cached.
